sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: As you take another step upward today, Taurus, you may realize that there's a large part of the mountain you hadn't accounted for before. Perhaps this steep portion of the climb wasn't visible from below when you started the trip. Don't panic. By overreacting to the unknown, you may lose your balance and go sliding down the face of the mountain. Collect yourself, rest, and plan your strategy one step at a time.

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: As the Gemini Moon and Jupiter align, the links between mental clarity, emotional fulfillment, and financial stability are strengthened. While maintaining gratitude for what you've built, gaze toward the future once Venus Rx, the nodes of fate, and Chiron activate later today. Build on existing dreams, and consider how your routines or plans must adjust as goals evolve. Allow your thoughts and emotions to connect after Luna enters Cancer this evening, but be mindful of how they influence each other when Neptune stirs tonight.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: Health will be perfect despite a hectic day. Today, with the help of a close relative, you can do well in your business, which will also benefit you financially. Family front seems to go smoothly and you can expect full support to your plans. Despite overburdened with work, you can remain energetic at your workplace. Today, you can complete all your tasks before the given scheduled time. Try your best to stay away from people. It's better to look out for and give ample time to yourself than people around you. Do you think that married life is all about compromises? If yes, you will know today that it's the best thing ever happened to you.

readings.text: Other people will try to convince you that a newer idea is best. Perhaps a new gadget just came out on the market that they are talking you into buying. Naturally, you will be skeptical. Don't be too rigid on this one. Be open to these new ideas.

readings.text: You have energy directed toward groups, politics, and self-employment. You have all the friends and contacts you need to begin a new venture, whether product, service, or project at your current job. You will also meet new people who can help you get where you want to be financially. At the same time, you're augmenting and transforming your union with other people. You have all the tools you need to get ahead.

readings.text: You could be incredibly stressed out today. Do you sometimes feel like everyone's therapist? Do others come to you and dump their sorrows and concerns, but you're too good a friend to reject them in their hour of need? If this is the case, you need to become unavailable in a hurry! Do something special for yourself. The little things you do to make yourself feel good may not be luxuries, but rather necessities, given the kind of week you've been having. It's OK to give yourself a boost every now and then!

lucky.remedy: Give sweetened rice to needy and poor people to strengthen your economic condition.

extras.text: As you move into a more inward phase, feel free to rearrange social obligations.
